summary.note: E073b skeptic (verification d) on B3 containment, B4 estimation variance, C3/C3b cover extrapolation. blr torch.linalg.inv crashed with MKL DLASWP in this process; a Cholesky inverse was monkeypatched in-process (--safe-inv). Refits reproduce saved preds (C1 vcz rel diff in C1.refit).

C1.verdict: survives in pooled corr (capacity, jackknife, comm_lin); concentrated in a few high-variance widespread species (equal-weight ~0); fails in MSE at T0 1996

C2.verdict: survives: not test-set selection; over-movement is a cross-place generalization gap (in-sample k ~1.06-1.08, CV k 0.67-0.75; fewer places -> lower k). win5 comparison was row-count confounded at T0 1996.

C3.verdict: cover-specific penalty for the covariate delta survives (twin control ~0; 7/8 regional seeds smaller), but random-6x6 control overstates it: regional loss costs -0.06 on average and up to -0.17 when it isolates as many beyond cells; DESK leg rests on a lucky random-drop run and a retrain effect that is n.s.
